answer: By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the zephyr until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
